stories.title: Marlins Man chats up Dua Lipa at her first baseball game
stories.summary: At Wednesday night's Game 3 of the Yankees-Rays ALDS, the broadcast kept catching Marlins Man, the famous fan in the orange jersey, chatting with Dua Lipa and her husband Callum Turner behind home plate. Afterward he posted "So i had no idea who this couple were and they were so nice and friendly to everyone" (138K likes), then added that it was her first baseball game and first American hot dog. The Rays won 4-3 to sweep the Yankees after a game-tying Anthony Volpe home run was overturned for fan interference.
